rules.sentence: Lesions lack a punctum and drain an oily fluid if ruptured; ruptured lesions can also become infected, called steatocystoma multiplex suppurativum.
Steatocystoma may coexist with a vellus hair cyst, but steatocystoma with trichoblastoma or trichoepithelioma is thought to portend an unfavorable prognosis.[29]
The coexistence of Alagille syndrome and steatocystomas is thought to portend a favorable prognosis.[30][31]
